name: Doutei!
source:
A battle to "lose the virginity" is started.
The rule is easy: make a girlfriend and have sex with her.
Kyosuke sets his target on a girl named Asami, but he really falls in love with her...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE057789.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一场“夺走处女之身”的战斗开始了。
规则很简单：交到女朋友，然后和她做爱。
京介把目标定在名叫麻美的女孩身上，却真的爱上了她……
